title: A Strong Harness Narrows the Model Gap: A Comparative Evaluation for Legislative Document-to-XML Conversion
abstract: arXiv:2610.19999v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Legal-content reproduction requires matching the source exactly in section hierarchy, verbatim text, citations, and amendment spans; a dropped citation or mislabeled amendment carries into the products lawyers rely on. We report an industrial pipeline converting U.S. state legislation into strict, schema-constrained XML, and hypothesize that its accuracy comes from harness engineering, the deterministic tooling built around a model, more than the model itself. Our controlled ablation crosses three harnesses (zero-shot, a single tool-using agent, and a decomposed multi-agent pipeline) with three Claude models on 153 gold bills from two jurisdictions. The harness narrows the model gap: the weakest model in the full pipeline beats the strongest model alone (0.948 versus 0.806, paired bootstrap p less than 0.001). translated_title: 强大的执行框架缩小模型差距：立法文档转XML转换的比较评估
translated_abstract: 法律内容的复现要求在章节层级、逐字文本、引用和修订条文等方面与原始文本完全一致；一个被遗漏的引用或错误标注的修订条文会传递到律师所依赖的产品中。我们报告了一条将美国州立法转换为严格的模式约束XML的工业流水线，并假设其准确性更多来自框架工程——即围绕模型构建的确定性工具——而非模型本身。我们在来自两个司法辖区的153份金标法案上进行了受控消融实验，将三种框架（零样本、单一工具使用代理、以及分解式多代理流水线）与三个Claude模型交叉组合。实验表明框架缩小了模型差距：完整流水线中最弱的模型击败了单独使用的最强模型（0.948对0.806，配对bootstrap p<0.001）。由于两个代理式框架共享完全相同的工具，它们之间的差距来自编排方式：任务分解加上持久化的状（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 在立法文档转XML的任务中，精心设计的确定性执行框架（尤其是多代理分解式编排）比模型本身更重要——流水线中最弱的模型表现超过了单独使用的最强模型。
en_tdlr: A strong deterministic harness—particularly a decomposed multi-agent pipeline—matters more than the model itself for legislative document-to-XML conversion, with the weakest model in the full pipeline outperforming the strongest model used alone.
